description: Submit a DataFrame of prompts as an Anthropic Message Batch (~50% cheaper than synchronous messages.create). Content-addressed idempotency: retries/re-runs with unchanged prompts reattach to the existing live batch instead of resubmitting. wait_for_completion=False (default) returns immediately with a small manifest -- no worker blocks waiting; pair with anthropic_batch_status_sensor + anthropic_batch_results.

outputs.description: Small manifest (batch_id/status/request_count), or the full parsed results DataFrame when wait_for_completion=True

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Upstream asset key providing a DataFrame of prompts

prompt_column.label: Prompt Column
prompt_column.description: Column containing the raw text to send as the user message. Set this OR prompt_template, not both.

prompt_template.label: Prompt Template
prompt_template.description: Format-string template using row values, e.g. "Summarize: {body}". Set this OR prompt_column, not both.

id_column.label: ID Column
id_column.description: Column to use as each row's custom_id (must match Anthropic's ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ pattern — a non-matching value raises a clear error rather than being silently mangled). If unset, the row's positional index (stringified) is used.

model.label: Model
model.description: Anthropic model id for each batch request

system_prompt.label: System Prompt
system_prompt.description: System prompt applied to every request in the batch

wait_for_completion.label: Wait For Completion
wait_for_completion.description: If True, poll in-process until the batch ends and return the full parsed results DataFrame. If False (default), submit/reattach and return only a small manifest (batch_id, processing_status, request_count) — the real results are fetched later by anthropic_batch_results once the status sensor confirms completion.

poll_interval_seconds.label: Poll Interval Seconds
poll_interval_seconds.description: Seconds between polls. Only used when wait_for_completion=True.

timeout_seconds.label: Timeout Seconds
timeout_seconds.description: Max seconds to wait for the batch to end before raising. Only used when wait_for_completion=True.

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Anthropic API key

owners.label: Owners
owners.description: Asset owners — list of team names or email addresses, e.g. ['team:analytics', 'user@company.com']

asset_tags.label: Asset Tags
asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags to apply to the asset, e.g. {'domain': 'finance', 'tier': 'gold'}

kinds.label: Kinds
kinds.description: Asset kinds for the Dagster catalog, e.g. ['anthropic', 'python']. Auto-inferred from component name if not set.

description.label: Description
description.description: Asset description shown in the Dagster catalog.

retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy. Useful for transient network failures, rate limits, etc.
